card.name: Drug prolongs the QT interval
card.fires_on: The final letter s of "prolongs" (or the word right after it) when a named drug is said to prolong the QT or QTc interval in warnings and interaction sections.

modes.label: prolong-s with QT
modes.description: The s ending of "prolongs" after a drug name, just before "the QT/QTc interval".
modes.example: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS QT Interval Prolongation: EXXUA prolong<<s>> the QTc.

modes.label: Word after prolongs
modes.description: The word "the" right after "prolongs" in the same QT statement.
modes.example: 5.2 QT Prolongation EXXUA prolongs<< the>> QTc interval

modes.label: Linking word in exposure or monitoring phrases
modes.description: A small linking word such as "for" or "of" in monitoring or drug-exposure sentences.
modes.example: Amlodipine may increase the systemic exposure<< of>> cyclosporine or tacrol
